source: The Streaming Multiprocessor is the central execution engine in ZXNAME0000XZ’s architecture. It is not just a bundle of arithmetic units. It contains the resources needed to keep many warps resident and make progress: a register file, shared-memory/L1 resources, warp scheduling and issue machinery, load/store paths, and multiple classes of functional units. Exact organization varies by compute capability.[1]
zh: 流式多处理器是 ZXNAME0000XZ 架构中的中央执行引擎。它不仅仅是一组算术单元。它包含保持许多 warp 驻留并取得进展所需的资源：寄存器文件、共享内存/L1 资源、warp 调度和发布机制、加载/存储路径以及多类功能单元。确切的组织因计算能力而异。[1]
